title: Cadmies Scientific Approach
definition: A commitment to adhering to scientific rigor in all aspects of CADMIES, from documentation to testing and analysis.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A set of rules and guidelines for conducting research in a way that follows scientific principles, ensuring reliable and accurate results.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A dedication to scientific rigor in the methodology, documentation, and analysis of CADMIES projects, aligning with the practices of a scientist.
difficulty_levels.expert: A unique approach to research within CADMIES that emphasizes the importance of scientific rigor, proper documentation, and rigorous testing and analysis, aligning with the practices of a scientist.

extra_fields.insight: The commitment to scientific rigor as a fundamental aspect of the CADMIES approach to research and data analysis.
